Beautiful Family Home for Sale in Constantia

ZAR 24,750,000~€1,327,330
  • 5 Bedrooms
  • 4.5 Bathrooms
  • ~2,012 m² Plot surface

Description

Nestled in a peaceful cul-de-sac in the heart of Constantia, this recently renovated family home offers spacious living, mountain views, and a wonderful lifestyle close to some of Cape Town's leading schools. Set on a generous property with a large landscaped garden, swimming pool, pool house and productive vegetable garden, this five-bedroom home is thoughtfully designed over two levels, providing both comfortable family living and excellent entertaining spaces. The ground floor features a spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area that flows seamlessly onto a private rear patio, creating an ideal indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Adjacent to the patio is a separate laundry room, as well as an external staff toilet. Also on this level is a separate living room, offering additional space for relaxation or entertaining. Three bedrooms are situated on the ground floor. Two bedrooms share a family bathroom, while the third bedroom enjoys the privacy of an en-suite bathroom and direct access to the garden. Upstairs, the generous main bedroom suite offers beautiful mountain views, ample cupboard space, and a spacious en-suite bathroom. A further smaller bedroom on this level is perfectly suited as a nursery, study, home office, or guest room. This exceptional Constantia home combines modern comfort, generous accommodation, and a tranquil setting, making it an ideal choice for families seeking space, privacy, and convenience in one of Cape Town's most sought-after suburbs.
